visual_requirements.description: Male immortal Titan represented in Greek art; human-form editorial face and fully opaque clothes.
Carries stolen fire hidden in hollow fennel stalk, tangible flame/ember.
Workshop of Hephaistos and Athena on Mount Olympus.

depicted_variant: Human-form Prometheus carrying stolen fire in hollow fennel from Olympian workshop.
aura: Documented stolen fire and hollow fennel(c10,c23), heroic unbending immortal spirit(c18) conveyed through determined action.
artistic_choices: Older weathered curly-bearded male visage is editorial, research identifies male Titan but does not prescribe exact beard.
Opaque brown woven tunic and wrap replace nude classical treatment.
No giant bodily scale, invented fire control or chains in fire-theft moment.
Workshop fire, sparks and lighting are physical tools and stolen flame, not aura.

Root Codex viewed both native compositions and selected variant A: Dua PNG native telah dibaca. A dipilih karena tangan dan batang fennel berlubang berisi bara/api curian mendominasi, badan berpaling meninggalkan bengkel membuat aksi jelas. Identitas Titan di seni Yunani c01/c14/c18; firefennel c10/c23. Athena di belakang berupa patung editorial sebagai konteks workshop c10, bukan tokoh hidup tambahan. B sah tetapi tangan kedua menutup api. Pakaian tertutup, tanpa gore/text/aura. Tujuh syarat Sangar terpenuhi.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Prometheus, heroic immortal Greek Titan taking the gift of fire from Olympus for humanity.
ANATOMY: one mature male Titan in human form, one head two eyes two arms two legs, determined weathered bearded face chosen editorially, fully opaque rough brown tunic and full leg wrap; hold ONE thick HOLLOW FENNEL STALK containing glowing real embers and fire at its open end [prometheus-c01,c14,c18,c10,c23].
POWER: stolen real fire hidden inside fennel stalk, NOT fire from his body, NOT ability to summon flame [prometheus-c10,c23].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close view, clenched hand, face, fennel ember opening dominate, no invented gigantic size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single furnace fire illuminates smoke, sparks and stark face shadows.
SURFACE: coarse woven opaque cloth, soot, green-brown fibrous hollow fennel, rough workshop stone.
SETTING: workshop of Hephaistos and Athena on Mount Olympus [prometheus-c10].
MOOD: unbending awe-inspiring heroic defiance(c18), no ordinary laborer pose or decorative calm portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/pseudo-glyphs/runes ANYWHERE on stone/tools/clothes, no logos/frames/watermarks, no extra anatomy, no film/game/comic designs, no nudity/gore, no aura/neon/ribbons.
MOMENT: Prometheus closes his hand around the hollow fennel and pulls it out of the fiery workshop into foreground, he glances intensely down toward viewer as sparks pour from ember opening. Twisting torso and direct determined gaze.
candidate_choice_notes: All seven Sangar yes: defiant Titan dominates close scene, stolen fire in hollow fennel(c10,c23) unmistakable, active extraction/protective stride, standard anatomy clothed, no letters or aura, workshop Olympus(c10). Preferred: strongest direct face and hollow ember opening.
